rules.title: Signals for decoupling
rules.text: Communicate upward with signals and downward with direct calls.

rules.title: Small scenes
rules.text: Build small reusable scenes and compose them instead of large monolithic scenes.

rules.title: Use the right callback
rules.text: Use _physics_process for physics and _process for frame updates, and multiply movement by delta.

rules.title: Resources for data
rules.text: Store shared data in Resource files instead of hardcoding values.
